title: Count Odd Letters from Number
summary: Given an integer n, convert each digit to its lowercase English word, concatenate these words maintaining the original order, and return the count of distinct characters that appear an odd number of times.
statement: Given an integer n, convert each digit to its lowercase English word, concatenate these words maintaining the original order, and return the count of distinct characters that appear an odd number of times.
constraints: Spell every decimal digit of n as its lowercase English word and concatenate in digit order.
Count character frequencies in the concatenated text.
Return how many distinct letters have odd frequency.
hints: Map each digit character to its fixed English word.
Concatenate words in original digit order.
Count letters across the complete result.
Sum one for each frequency with odd parity.
editorial: Sum one for each frequency with odd parity.
